name: rwaUSDi
oneLiner: rwaUSDi is Multipli's KYB-gated RWA wrapper of Treasury-backed stablecoins, tokenized gold, and market-neutral fund units with Lloyd's depeg insurance.
collateral: Basket of 100+ Treasury-backed stablecoins and tokenized gold assets aggregated by Multipli; peg stability backed by Lloyd's insurance covering de-pegging risk
pegMechanism: NAV-based valuation of underlying RWA basket; KYB-gated 1:1 minting and redemption restricted to verified institutional counterparties

controls.label: Multipli rwaUSDi issuance/peg module
controls.evidence: Multipli aggregates externally-issued tokenized RWAs into a single unit; KYB-verified institutions mint rwaUSDi against deposited collateral at NAV and redeem through scheduled windows, with Multipli controlling the compliance-gated issuance engine.

review.evidence: Multipli docs describe rwaUSDi as an isolated, compliance-gated (KYB) liquidity class where institutions deposit supported tokenized RWAs and mint a unified collateral unit at NAV; Multipli operates the issuance/peg module and access is restricted to KYB-verified entities, so this is an issuer-controlled mint rather than a single-parent wrapper or permissionless route.
